title: Him mouth almighty and his boiled eyes
html_source:
Molly remembers an encounter with John Henry Menton at Mat Dillon’s in Roundtown many years earlier during which they danced. She clearly was no admirer of his but the detail, tone and caustic language very quickly ‘flesh out’ what has been up to now a flat character called ‘Molly’.

mouth almighty – Slang: ‘he has a high opinion of himself’, (Gifford).
